rule: This file is committed BEFORE the calibration harness is run even once. Candidates are never added after calibration. Adding one is a revision of DESIGN_S7_run8.md and must record the addition and its reason.

analysis_stack_pin.note: ANALYSIS_STACK_PIN as enforced by scripts/run5_bootstrap.py (gates stage). No new extractor is introduced by B-1.

voicing.call: librosa.pyin(y, sr=44100, fmin=librosa.note_to_hz('C2'), fmax=librosa.note_to_hz('C6'), frame_length=round(window_ms*sr/1000), hop_length=round(hop_ms*sr/1000), center=True)
voicing.provenance: same call shape as s1_dataprep/convert_user.py::_f0_median_hz (T1/T2 note assignment)

voicing.call: frame RMS >= 1e-3 AND normalized autocorrelation peak r > 0.35 over lag range [sr/700, sr/80]
voicing.f0_from: sr / argmax-lag of the normalized autocorrelation
voicing.provenance: identical voicing mechanism to scripts/measure_bands.py::hnr_median_db (absolute RMS floor 1e-3, r > 0.35). No new mechanism is introduced.

mel_call: librosa.feature.melspectrogram(y=y, sr=44100, n_fft=n_fft, hop_length=hop_length, n_mels=n_mels, power=2.0, htk=False, fmin=0.0, fmax=22050.0)
